error[ZBX-E0905]: no trusted signature covers what was to run
  cause  /home/alice/.config/zbx/policy.zon requires a signature
         (require_signature), and nothing has signed
         registry-1.docker.io/library/alpine@sha256:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012345...
  fix    sign it with a key the policy lists:   zbx sign registry-1.docker.io/library/alpine@sha256:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
         or add the signer's key to the policy file
  more   zbx explain E0905 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0905.html
